```{r}
#| results: asis
library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)
library(commonmark)

works_data <- read_csv("works/works.csv")

# Function to convert markdown to HTML
render_markdown <- function(text) {
  HTML(markdown_html(text))
}

# Functions to construct paths (for presentation-type entries)
make_slides_path <- function(name) {
  paste0("https://pingfan-hu.github.io/", name, "/")
}

make_pdf_path <- function(name) {
  paste0(file.path("/works", name), ".pdf")
}

make_github_path <- function(name) {
  paste0("https://github.com/pingfan-hu/", name)
}

# A small pill action (icon + text). Cards draw these above their stretched
# main link, so each stays a link of its own.
work_btn <- function(href, icon, label) {
  a(
    href = href,
    class = "work-btn",
    target = "_blank",
    rel = "noopener noreferrer",
    tags$i(class = paste0("bi ", icon)),
    tags$span(label)
  )
}

# Button labels live in the CSV (Btn1Label/Btn2Label/Btn3Label); the fallback
# only guards rows where a label cell is left blank.
btn_label <- function(label, fallback) {
  if (is.na(label) || !nzchar(label)) fallback else label
}

# A paper's document links, from the Doc columns in the CSV, as
# list(href, icon, label). The icon is inferred from the label (website,
# PDF/paper, or other document).
paper_docs <- function(Doc1Label, Doc1URL, Doc2Label, Doc2URL) {
  make <- function(label, url) {
    if (is.na(url) || !nzchar(url)) return(NULL)
    key <- tolower(label)
    icon <- if (grepl("website", key)) "bi-globe2"
      else if (grepl("pdf|paper", key)) "bi-file-earmark-pdf"
      else "bi-file-earmark-text"
    list(href = url, icon = icon, label = label)
  }
  Filter(Negate(is.null), list(make(Doc1Label, Doc1URL), make(Doc2Label, Doc2URL)))
}

# A paper's "Cite" pill: copies its APA reference (markdown italics dropped).
cite_btn <- function(reference) {
  if (is.na(reference) || !nzchar(reference)) return(NULL)
  tags$button(
    class = "work-btn work-cite",
    type = "button",
    `data-cite` = gsub("*", "", reference, fixed = TRUE),
    tags$i(class = "bi bi-quote"),
    tags$span("Cite")
  )
}

# An event cell may hold markdown links; drop the paragraph commonmark wraps it in.
inline_markdown <- function(text) {
  HTML(sub("^<p>(.*)</p>\n?$", "\\1", markdown_html(text)))
}

# A note after the date, from the Status column (e.g. a paper never published).
work_status <- function(status) {
  if (is.na(status) || !nzchar(status)) return(NULL)
  span(class = "work-status", status)
}

short_date <- function(date, type) {
  switch(type,
    paper = format(date, "%Y"),
    storybook = , workshop = format(date, "%b %Y"),
    paste0(format(date, "%b "), as.integer(format(date, "%d")), format(date, ", %Y"))
  )
}

# A work card: the thumbnail (works/thumbs/{Name}.jpg, made by
# resources/scripts/work-thumbs.R), the title, which is the card's main link
# and stretches over it, the event and date, then pills for its other links.
# The main link is what the thumbnail shows: the deck, the site, the paper or
# the poster; it gets no pill of its own.
create_work <- function(Date, Title, Event, Location, Name, Type = "slide",
                        Btn1Label = NA, Btn2Label = NA, Btn3Label = NA,
                        Doc1Label = NA, Doc1URL = NA, Doc2Label = NA, Doc2URL = NA,
                        Reference = NA, Status = NA) {
  type <- if (is.na(Type)) "slide" else tolower(Type)

  links <- switch(type,
    slide = list(
      list(href = make_slides_path(Name), icon = "bi-easel", label = btn_label(Btn1Label, "Slides")),
      list(href = make_pdf_path(Name), icon = "bi-file-earmark-pdf", label = btn_label(Btn2Label, "PDF")),
      list(href = make_github_path(Name), icon = "bi-github", label = btn_label(Btn3Label, "GitHub"))
    ),
    workshop = , storybook = list(
      list(href = make_slides_path(Name), icon = "bi-globe", label = btn_label(Btn1Label, "Website")),
      list(href = make_github_path(Name), icon = "bi-github", label = btn_label(Btn2Label, "GitHub"))
    ),
    paper = paper_docs(Doc1Label, Doc1URL, Doc2Label, Doc2URL),
    list(list(href = make_pdf_path(Name), icon = "bi-file-earmark-pdf", label = btn_label(Btn1Label, "PDF")))
  )
  # a paper opens on its website where it has one, else its PDF
  main <- if (type == "paper") {
    web <- Filter(function(l) l$icon == "bi-globe2", links)
    pdf <- Filter(function(l) l$icon == "bi-file-earmark-pdf", links)
    c(web, pdf, links)[[1]]
  } else links[[1]]
  pills <- Filter(function(l) !identical(l, main), links)

  thumb <- file.path("works/thumbs", paste0(Name, ".jpg"))
  div(
    class = paste("work-card", paste0("is-", type)),
    if (file.exists(thumb)) div(class = "work-thumb", tags$img(src = thumb, alt = "", loading = "lazy")),
    div(
      class = "work-body",
      div(class = "work-title",
        a(class = "work-link", href = main$href, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener noreferrer", Title)),
      div(
        class = "work-meta",
        span(class = "work-event", inline_markdown(Event)),
        span(class = "work-date", short_date(Date, type)),
        work_status(Status)
      ),
      if (length(pills) || type == "paper") div(
        class = "work-actions",
        lapply(pills, function(l) work_btn(l$href, l$icon, l$label)),
        if (type == "paper") cite_btn(Reference)
      )
    )
  )
}

build_works <- function(data) {
  if (nrow(data) == 0) return(list())
  pmap(data, create_work)
}

storybook_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type) & tolower(Type) == "storybook") %>%
  build_works()

workshop_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type) & tolower(Type) == "workshop") %>%
  build_works()

paper_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type) & tolower(Type) == "paper") %>%
  build_works()

slide_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(is.na(Type) | tolower(Type) == "slide") %>%
  build_works()

poster_works <- works_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Type) & tolower(Type) == "poster") %>%
  build_works()

# Wrap a group of cards under an editorial section header:
# a small icon chip + Maple Mono label + a thin hairline rule. The `variant`
# class carries the section's soft accent color (see styles.scss). `slug`
# is the scroll anchor id used by the category locator.
work_section <- function(title, icon, items, variant, slug, grid) {
  div(
    class = paste("pres-section", variant),
    id = slug,
    div(
      class = "pres-section-head",
      span(class = "pres-section-icon", tags$i(class = paste0("bi ", icon))),
      span(class = "pres-section-title", title),
      span(class = "pres-section-rule")
    ),
    div(class = paste("work-grid", grid), items)
  )
}

# A category locator link (icon + label): a table-of-contents-style anchor that
# smooth-scrolls to its section. Carries the section's variant class so it
# themes with that section's accent color.
nav_link <- function(label, icon, slug, variant) {
  a(
    href = paste0("#", slug),
    class = paste("pres-filter-btn", variant),
    `data-target` = slug,
    tags$i(class = paste0("bi ", icon)),
    tags$span(label)
  )
}

# Single source of truth for the sections — drives both the locator and the
# rendered sections, and drops any category that has no entries.
# Each section's grid: slides three to a row, papers and posters two, and the
# two single-entry sections (a workshop, a storybook) side by side in one row
# (`pair`), so no card stands alone across the page.
sections <- list(
  list(title = "Workshops",  icon = "bi-people",            items = workshop_works,  variant = "pres-teal",   slug = "workshops",  grid = "cols-1", pair = TRUE),
  list(title = "Storybooks", icon = "bi-journal-bookmark",  items = storybook_works, variant = "pres-rose",   slug = "storybooks", grid = "cols-1", pair = TRUE),
  list(title = "Papers",     icon = "bi-file-earmark-text", items = paper_works,     variant = "pres-violet", slug = "papers",     grid = "cols-2", pair = FALSE),
  list(title = "Slides",     icon = "bi-easel",             items = slide_works,     variant = "pres-blue",   slug = "slides",     grid = "cols-3", pair = FALSE),
  list(title = "Posters",    icon = "bi-image",             items = poster_works,    variant = "pres-amber",  slug = "posters",    grid = "cols-2", pair = FALSE)
)
sections <- Filter(function(s) length(s$items) > 0, sections)

filter_box <- tags$aside(
  class = "pres-filter",
  div(class = "pres-filter-title", "Types"),
  tags$nav(
    class = "pres-filter-list",
    lapply(sections, function(s) nav_link(s$title, s$icon, s$slug, s$variant))
  )
)

rendered <- lapply(sections, function(s) {
  work_section(s$title, s$icon, s$items, s$variant, s$slug, s$grid)
})
paired <- vapply(sections, function(s) s$pair, logical(1))
# the paired sections go in one row, where the first of them stood
section_cards <- if (sum(paired) == 2) {
  first <- which(paired)[1]
  c(rendered[seq_len(first - 1)],
    list(div(class = "pres-pair", rendered[paired])),
    rendered[!paired & seq_along(rendered) > first])
} else rendered
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
div(
  class = "presentations-page",
  filter_box,
  div(class = "pres-main", section_cards)
)
```
